about: The catalogue's arrangement: shelves, subjects and series, by id. Edited directly; everything else the catalogue shows is derived by scripts/catalogue/build-catalogue.mjs.

shelves.name: Historic Geographies
shelves.blurb: The territorial fabric: the units Ireland has been divided into, from the townland up.

shelves.name: Government & Administration
shelves.blurb: Who administers what, and the areas they administer it over.

shelves.name: Elections & Representation
shelves.blurb: The geography of voting: the areas, where the vote happens, and how it came out.

shelves.name: People & Places
shelves.blurb: Where people are, what the places are called, and how they are counted.

shelves.name: Planning & Property
shelves.blurb: What is proposed, permitted and owned.

shelves.name: Heritage & Culture
shelves.blurb: What was built, what was left behind, and where culture happens.

shelves.name: Local Services & Amenities
shelves.blurb: What a council provides and where you go to use it.

shelves.name: Water
shelves.blurb: Fresh and salt: where it is, how clean it is, and where it goes when it rises.

shelves.name: Environment & Land Use
shelves.blurb: The living surface, how it is used, and what is done to it.

shelves.name: Earth & Terrain
shelves.blurb: What is under the ground and the shape of what is on top of it.
